visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) High-intensity gameplay footage of a MOBA game (Arena of Valor) fills the frame, showcasing colorful particle effects, health bars, and rapid character movements. (2) A young man (Zhan) appears in an inset overlay wearing a white and blue 'FLASH WOLVES' e-sports jersey; he speaks with a focused facial expression while game action continues in the background. (3) The scene cuts to a large e-sports stage celebration where a group of young men in team jerseys are hugging and cheering amidst falling golden confetti and bright stage lights. (4) A large black and gold podium with 'GCS SUMMER SEASON 2024 CHAMPION' printed on it is the centerpiece of the stage. (5) Zhan is then shown in a professional studio setting, framed in a medium shot against a vibrant blue and purple background, speaking directly to the camera with calm gestures. (6) The final phase is a static graphic layout with the text 'RE-SIGN' and a portrait of Zhan, accompanied by brand logos and contact information.
